scope: Theatrical and streaming poster art from the owner’s movie collection. Each file identifies a specific film and release year.
processing: Aspect ratio preserved, resized to at most 420 × 630 without enlargement, then encoded as WebP.
rights: Copyright remains with the respective rights holders. No republication license has been verified. The site’s software license does not cover these images.
credits: The production company or distributor identifies the film. Poster designers, illustrators and photographers are credited where identified for this specific artwork.
